limitations: Native instruction-driven virtual clock versus count-free browser yield clock; no equal-work or cycle-accuracy claim.

Super Miners browser result is median of 244.26, 359.39 and 352.10 FPS; low sample retained and variability unexplained.
Startup/navigation excluded; residual translation and browser/native JIT work included.
Guest sound processed with browser host output muted and native host output discarded; audible quality not retested.
